title: Turn network errors into a response
prompt: Create `src/offline.ts` that exports `const offlineMiddleware: Middleware` (`Middleware` from openapi-typesafe-fetch). When a request cannot be sent at all (fetch rejects, for example when offline), the call must resolve as a 503 response with the JSON body `{ "code": "offline", "message": "The network is unavailable" }` instead of rejecting.
